operation.description:
Creates or updates an environment secret with an encrypted value. Encrypt your secret using
[LibSodium](https://libsodium.gitbook.io/doc/bindings_for_other_languages). For more information, see "[Encrypting secrets for the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/encrypting-secrets-for-the-rest-api)."

Authenticated users must have collaborator access to a repository to create, update, or read secrets.

OAuth tokens and personal access tokens (classic) need the `repo` scope to use this endpoint.

encrypted_value.description: Value for your secret, encrypted with [LibSodium](https://libsodium.gitbook.io/doc/bindings_for_other_languages) using the public key retrieved from the [Get an environment public key](https://docs.github.com/rest/actions/secrets#get-an-environment-public-key) endpoint.

key_id.description: ID of the key you used to encrypt the secret.

operation.summary: Create or update an environment secret

#/components/parameters/environment-name.description: The name of the environment. The name must be URL encoded. For example, any slashes in the name must be replaced with `%2F`.
#/components/parameters/environment-name.name: environment_name

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo
